title: Spices and Condiments - Methods of Sampling
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes the sampling procedure for spices and condiments in different forms, such as, whole, seeds and powder. It covers the material in bulk as well as the material packed in containers.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Spices and Condiments - Methods of Test (Third Revision)

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
